verdict.rationale: WorkOS Audit Logs lets apps emit and export events as a compliance and security paper trail of sensitive actions by organization members, and pricing lists "Log streaming (per SIEM connection)" for streaming audit logs to a SIEM. That covers the core capture-and-stream story, but only through first-party docs. Missing for 10: any evidence of tamper-evidence or immutability guarantees, documentation that authentication events are captured automatically rather than emitted by the developer, details of supported SIEM destinations and formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
